design.text: Single-arm, multicenter, multicohort trial of elranatamab monotherapy; enrolled two independent parallel cohorts (Cohort A naive to BCMA-directed therapy; Cohort B with prior BCMA-directed therapy).

citations.quote: The data to support the proposed indication is based on Study C1071003 (MagnetisMM-3), a Phase 1/2, single-arm, multicenter, multicohort trial evaluating elranatamab monotherapy in patients with relapsed or refractory MM (RRMM).

This study enrolled patients in two independent and parallel cohorts. Cohort A included patients who are naïve to BCMA-directed therapy with a planned enrollment of 120 patients. Cohort B included patients previously exposed to BCMA-directed therapy with a planned enrollment of 60 patients.

indication.text: ELREXFIO is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who have received at least four prior lines of therapy, including a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory agent, and an anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody.

target_moa.text: Elranatamab is a bispecific BCMA-directed and CD3-directed T-cell engaging antibody; it binds BCMA on multiple myeloma cells and CD3 on T-cells, activating T-cells to release cytokines and lyse BCMA-expressing myeloma cells.

citations.quote: Elranatamab (also referred to as PF-06863135) is a bispecific antibody directed against B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA) and cluster of differentiation 3 (CD3). BCMA is expressed on the surface of multiple myeloma (MM) and plasma cells, and CD3 is expressed on the surface of T-cells. Elranatamab directs T-cell mediated lysis of MM cells and the proposed indication is relapsed or refractory MM.

Elranatamab-bcmm is a bispecific B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA)-directed T-cell engaging antibody that binds BCMA on plasma cells, plasmablasts, and multiple myeloma cells and CD3 on T-cells leading to cytotoxicity of the BCMA-expressing cells.

modality.text: bispecific (BCMA-directed CD3 T-cell engaging bispecific antibody)

citations.quote: Elranatamab is a BCMA-directed CD3 T-cell engaging bispecific monoclonal antibody.

detail.text: Boxed warning for Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS), including life-threatening or fatal reactions, and Neurologic Toxicity, including Immune Effector Cell-Associated Neurotoxicity Syndrome (ICANS); ELREXFIO is available only through a restricted REMS program.

citations.quote: ## WARNING: CYTOKINE RELEASE SYNDROME and NEUROLOGIC TOXICITY including IMMUNE EFFECTOR CELL-ASSOCIATED NEUROTOXICITY SYNDROME

Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS), including life-threatening or fatal reactions, can occur in patients receiving ELREXFIO. Initiate treatment with ELREXFIO step-up dosing schedule to reduce the risk of CRS. Withhold ELREXFIO until CRS resolves or permanently discontinue based on severity [see *Dosage and Administration* (2.2, 2.5), *Warnings and Precautions* (5.1)].

detail.text: ELREXFIO is available only through a restricted program under a REMS called the ELREXFIO REMS because of the risks of CRS and neurologic toxicity, including ICANS. Prescribers, pharmacies, and healthcare settings must be certified with the program.
